audit.why: 52.15% over 1279 games supports the page's FAV / 7/10 reading, and the mirror aligned its diff to FAV as well. Lillia owns level 1 with a 6s Q and stacking move speed; Sett owns everything from Facebreaker at 3 until she has items and a team to sleep for.
audit.corrected: FAV for Sett in lane, Lillia-favoured once fights are five-on-five.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Skill/Skill/Lillia/Skill/Lillia/Lillia, which hands Lillia levels 4-5 and first item — the exact stages this page's own whys say Sett wins ('you keep catching her paper body with the E-Q-W combo'). The mirror flipped rows 0, 2, 3 and 5 to Lillia / Sett / Sett / Sett. Separately, whys[4] and whys[5] are shifted one stage: whys[4] discusses level 5 in the level-6 row, and whys[5] discusses level 6 in the first-item row.
audit.why: Packet chart, mirror and the page's own prose agree on the corrected owners; the off-by-one whys made the chart read as if the level-6 spike belonged to the first-item stage.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lillia / Sett / Sett / Sett / Skill / Sett / Lillia in both layers, ratings re-scaled, phases[0] and phases[3] whys rewritten, and whys[4]/whys[5] re-pointed at the stages they actually label.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave no number and no mechanic — 'her kite + move speed stacks'. Nothing on the page states that Blooming Blows deals TRUE damage on its outer edge, or that Swirlseed keeps rolling until it hits a wall.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'dealing extra true damage on the edge' — so resistances do not answer her poke, and standing at max range of her spin is the worst place to be. Swirlseed is a flat 12s at 700 range and rolls on if it hits nothing, which is how she cuts off a Sett with no dash.
audit.corrected: Blooming Blows: 6s at rank 1, 4s at rank 5, true damage on the outer edge — hug her, do not stand at the rim. Swirlseed: flat 12s, 700 range, keeps rolling until it hits terrain. Lilting Lullaby: 150s at rank 1.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Lillia on every CS, but respect her opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Blooming Blows is 6s at rank 1 and her stacking move speed keeps her out of your hands, so level 1 is hers. Soak XP, let Pit Grit heal the chip, wait for three.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Lillia has her core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield her return damage, out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay yours — Facebreaker is 11.5s by rank 4 and pins her out of the spin. Bank her burn as grit, then cash Haymaker on her paper body.

edits.after: - Blooming Blows (Q): 6s at rank 1, 4s at rank 5 — its outer edge is TRUE damage, so hug her.

edits.before: Her kite + move speed stacks. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Skill window — she out-ranges and out-mobiles you with passive movespeed, so your first item lets you survive her burn while you hunt a catch.
edits.after: First item is yours: grit walks you through her burn while you hunt a catch. Swirlseed is a flat 12s and rolls until it hits a wall — dodge it or it slows you out of the engage.
